subject: Request for Pollination Contract Details
body_text:
Hi there,  

I hope this message finds you well! We're gearing up for the upcoming season and would like to request a new pollination contract for our almond orchard. We're looking for the same hive count as last year, which was 40 hives, for delivery around the start of the almond bloom. Please confirm if you can accommodate a split delivery, as we’d like to stagger our hives to optimize pollination.  

Additionally, if there are any new considerations or updates regarding your services, please let us know. Thanks for your assistance!  

Best,  
Mark Lee  
St. Agnes Pollination

subject: Pollination Contract Request for Riverbend Family Orchards
body_text:
Dear [Apiarist Sales Rep's Name], 

I hope this message finds you well! We would like to proceed with our pollination needs for the almond segment this year. Please prepare a contract for 15 hives to be delivered to our orchard by February 15th, aligning with the same schedule as last year. If possible, we’d like to arrange for a split delivery, with the second batch coming just before peak bloom. 

Let me know if you need any additional information to move forward. Thank you for your assistance!

Best,  
Victoria Larson  
Riverbend Family Orchards

subject: Pollination Contract Request for Mesa Orchard Co.
body_text:
Hi there! 

I hope you’re doing well. I would like to request a pollination contract for our upcoming season. We need 40 hives for our blueberry block, which should align with last year's schedule around the bloom period. Ideally, we’d like to have the hives delivered by mid-April. If possible, please confirm if split delivery can be arranged as we may need additional support later in the season. 

Thanks for your assistance! Looking forward to your prompt response. 

Best,  
Jessica Gross  
Mesa Orchard Co.
